JOB DESCRIPTION 
  • Bachelor's Degree 
 • 2-5 years of Microsoft .NET development (C# or VB .NET) using Microsoft Visual Studio 
 • 2-5 years of experience with the following: 
 ◦ HTML 
 ◦ CSS 
 ◦ ASP.NET 
 ◦ jQuery 
 • Object oriented development 
 • Strong understanding of Structured Query Language (SQL) 
 • Knowledge of relational databases (Oracle, MS SQL) 
 • U.S. Citizen 
 • Must be able to pass security background investigation
 

 

 Preferred Qualifications:   
 

 • XML experience 
 • Experience in using Source Control Systems (i.e. Source Safe, Team Foundation Server, etc.) 
 • Microsoft .NET developer certification 
 • CompTIA Security+ Certification
 



 

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
